newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on soybean rally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on soybean rally.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply higher on Monday, boosted by limit gains in soybeans, traders said.
"We spent most of the day looking for direction and of course, beans gave us that direction," a trader said.
Strength also came from speculation USDA would trim ending stocks projections for rice in Tuesday's crop report.
"We've got a report coming out tomorrow and there's no way they can make it bearish," a floor source said. "With Freedom to Farm, we've got to stay toe to toe (with soybeans) to buy acreage."
Analysts have suggested farmers in the U.S. Delta would plant soybeans instead of rice because soybean prices have rallied sharply.
Rice futures volume was estimated by CBOT at 700 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 2,308 lots.
